notes: הִיא is realized by the relative *which* (rule 17), and the copula *was* goes to the nominal predicate שָׁנָה under rule 20.

The assimilated `[הַ]` of בַּשָּׁנָה takes the written *the* (rule 12) while the ordinal's agreement article is unrepresented (rule 47); the second `[הַ]` is unrepresented because the ASV writes no *the* for *king Hezekiah*.
